sections.title: Military History
content: Former Captain of Special Operations, Iron Army
Led elite forces during the invasion of Esseg
Personally killed Aleksandar Vuk (closely guarded secret)
Signatory of the Accords after the war
Commands respect among Iron Army veterans

sections.title: Secret Identity
content: Distant cousin of Aleksandar Vuk (unknown to everyone)
Wolf is his family line symbol (same as Vuk's)
Has access to Vuk's bloodline-based technology (bunker)
This connection will be explored in future books

sections.title: Post-War Life
content: Chose to become police detective to serve his people
Considers himself godfather/uncle to all Young Conquerors
Feels oath-bound by the Accords to protect Iron Army remnants
Lives with the moral weight of his wartime actions

coreTraits: Protective of Iron Army community, especially younger generation
Haunted by his role in the war
Pragmatic - willing to break rules for the greater good
motivations: Protecting Iron Army remnants in Esseg
Ensuring Young Conquerors have a future
Maintaining order between Conquerors and Natives
internalConflicts: Struggles between following the law vs. delivering justice
Tension between his role as protector and his past as executioner
Questions whether his duty is to 'his people' or to everyone

details: Detective partner since after the war
Share whiskey ritual at end of difficult days
Deep trust, but tested by the case
Veckurius represents integration; Sek represents Iron Army interests
Knows their parents, checks on their wellbeing
Their exploitation by Titovsky is deeply personal
Hal Cyon's death particularly affects him
Respects her role as spiritual leader
Undergoes trial by ordeal under her guidance

sections.title: Act I - Duty
content: Investigates Hal Cyon's murder
Initially believes it's tragic accident involving Young Conquerors
Partners with Veckurius to uncover the truth

sections.title: Act II - Conflict
content: Discovers Young Conquerors being used by Titovsky
Feels personally responsible for their exploitation
Conflicts with Veckurius over loyalties and methods

sections.title: Act III - Resolution
content: Undergoes trial by ordeal with the Oracle
Accepts he must break the rules to protect his people
Reactivates his old special forces team
Conducts extrajudicial operation to destroy Red Death shipment and gangs
Gets blood on his hands again

characterArc.before: Believes he can protect his people by working within the system, following the Accords
characterArc.after: Accepts that sometimes protection requires moral compromise; becomes both protector and executioner again

skillsAndAbilities: Access to elite special forces operatives

notableMoments.description: Recognizes Hal Cyon's body, is saddened
Undergoes drug-induced vision quest with the Oracle
Makes connection between 'wolf phrase' on radio and Zekovich

storySignificance: Embodies themes of duty, moral compromise, and coexistence
His secret connection to Vuk sets up series-long mystery
His decision to break the rules drives the resolution
His relationship with Veckurius explores Native/Conqueror tensions

nextBook: Faces consequences of his extrajudicial actions
futureBooks: Will be revealed to have split personality - becomes serial killer
